frozen_theorems.bare_nonclosure: DBO({a},{b}) AND ((NOT a) OR (NOT b)) = XOR(a,b), which is nonmonotone; every positive DBO is monotone.
frozen_theorems.chain: canonical first-satisfied-literal decision chain, final all-false branch FALSE
frozen_theorems.clause_canonicalization: remove duplicate literals; complementary pair makes C=TRUE; deterministic literal order; otherwise each literal uses a distinct surviving variable
frozen_theorems.closure: Phi AND C iff OR_r (G_r AND Phi_r)
frozen_theorems.guards: G_r=(NOT ell_1) AND ... AND (NOT ell_(r-1)) AND ell_r; guards are pairwise disjoint and OR_r G_r iff C
frozen_theorems.leaf: Phi_r=RESTRICT(Phi,rho_r) belongs to DBO/TRUE/FALSE by sealed BA21 restriction closure
frozen_theorems.model_count: sum branch leaf counts over free variables because first-true guards are disjoint; assigned dimensions handled explicitly
frozen_theorems.restriction: RESTRICT(DGDBO,rho) remains DGDBO/DBO/TRUE/FALSE after pruning, test simplification and BA21 leaf restriction
frozen_theorems.scope: foreign C references only surviving variables after BA21 projection; carrier realization of arbitrary foreign clause is NOT part of BA22

representation.dbo_semantics: OR over nonempty pairwise-disjoint positive conjunction blocks
representation.dg_dbo: restricted literal-decision DAG with DBO/TRUE/FALSE leaves and source/proof provenance

scientific_target: For one arbitrary canonical foreign clause C over surviving BA21 DBO variables, prove bare positive-variable DBO nonclosure, then certify exact polynomial-size PC_DGDBO_V1 decision-guarded closure without BA20 prime-CNF materialization.
